sections.kicker: Prepared for Designaholic by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Designaholic has six seasons of Mexican design voices. The front door talks like any design newsletter.
sections.keep: Your bio, "Amplificamos la conversación sobre la cultura de diseño y las industrias creativas a través de sus protagonistas". It names the people, not the trends.

meet first.

pins.quote: Lo más relevante del diseño, cada semana.
pins.what: The site's promise is a line any design outlet could print.
pins.why: Your edge is the protagonists of Mexican design, and this line leaves them out.
pins.how: Put the people and the country in the promise.
pins.label: Your site
pins.cost: New visitors read you as one more design digest.

pins.what: 287 episodes is an archive nobody else in Mexico has.
pins.why: It is proof of authority, shown as one more item in a feed.
pins.how: Present the episodes as a library of Mexican design, searchable by person.
pins.label: Your podcast
pins.cost: The archive works as content once and then disappears.

pins.what: Instagram sends 81K people to a link page template.
pins.why: A design culture brand hands its front door to a tool with no design of its own.
pins.how: Point the bio to your own site, where the voice is yours.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The first click after the grid looks like everyone else's.
